sources_quoted.text: Dealing {{as|physical damage}} to an enemy champion applies a stack of ''Carve'' for 6 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. Each stack inflicts {{as|6% armor reduction}}, up to {{as|30%|armor}} at 5 stacks.

After using an ability, your next basic attack within 10 seconds deals {{as|100% '''base''' AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} [[on-hit]]. If the target is a champion, inflict them with ''Expose Weakness'' for 4 seconds, causing them to take {{rd|8%|5%}} increased damage from all sources ({{fd|1.5}} second cooldown, starts after using the empowered attack).

sources_quoted.text: Black Cleaver average stacks (ArmorReductionEffect.average_reduction): the established model uses a fixed 0.8·max_stacks constant (with a hits/2 short-fight branch) ... the exact Cesàro mean of the capped ramp min(k, C) over h hits is C − C(C−1)/(2h) for h ≥ C; the constant model equals the exact mean at ~10 autos and deviates by up to ±20% at the extremes.

independent_computation.method: The scenario's input tuple (attacker, level, ranks, enemy armor, hit counts) is defined in scripts/ + tests/, which this runbook forbids reading, and is NOT reproducible from data/ (grep for 'cleaver_bloodsong', 'coupled_scenarios', '_roster' over the whole export returns nothing; data/practice-corpus/scenarios.json contains no cleaver/bloodsong scenario). The absolute value therefore cannot be re-derived end to end from the permitted evidence. What CAN be derived exactly from the cached sources is the set of multipliers this leaf is allowed to move by, and the observed old->new ratio is then tested against each.

observed_ratio.note: leaf values are displayed to 0.1, so old ∈ [282.35, 282.45] and new ∈ [297.45, 297.55]

candidate_mechanisms_tested.mechanism: Expose Weakness (ranged holder, 5%) newly applied to this source, any uptime u ≤ 1
candidate_mechanisms_tested.result: IMPOSSIBLE — 1.0500 < 1.05311 (lower edge of the rounding window). 282.4 × 1.05 = 296.5, not 297.5.

candidate_mechanisms_tested.mechanism: Expose Weakness (melee holder, 8%) newly applied at FULL uptime
Expose Weakness (melee holder, 8%) newly applied over its documented 4 s window at uptime u
candidate_mechanisms_tested.result: MATCH at u = 2/3 exactly: 1 + 0.08·(4/6) = 1.0533333; 282.4 × 1.0533333 = 297.4613 -> displays 297.5. u = 2/3 is the natural landing point for a 4 s debuff over a 6 s window (or 2 of 3 amplified damage instances), and is the only clean fraction inside the admissible band.

candidate_mechanisms_tested.mechanism: Black Cleaver: 0.8·max_stacks constant (4 stacks, 24% reduction) -> exact Cesàro mean C − C(C−1)/(2h) = 5 − 10/h, per docs/math-foundations.md §2.3
candidate_mechanisms_tested.result: IMPOSSIBLE at any realistic armor — h=10 gives ratio 1.0000 (the constant IS the exact mean there), h=20 gives at most 1.0411, h=60 at most 1.0704 but needs A ≈ 444 to reach 1.05347. Reaching the observed ratio needs armor ≳ 237 even in the h→∞ limit. Rules the documented BC-averaging correction out as the cause of this leaf's move.

candidate_mechanisms_tested.mechanism: Black Cleaver 4 stacks (24%) -> full 5 stacks (30%), no amp change
candidate_mechanisms_tested.result: ARITHMETICALLY POSSIBLE but requires a heavily itemized ~237-armor target and would mean the engine jumped to full max stacks — which contradicts BOTH the old 0.8·C constant AND the exact Cesàro mean (which never reaches C). This is the residual hypothesis under which the verdict would be both_wrong; see limitations.

reasoning_for_verdict: The cached Bloodsong text is explicit that Expose Weakness makes the target 'take 8%/5% increased damage from ALL sources' — exactly the cross-source coupling a scenario named 'cleaver_bloodsong_roster' exists to pin. The old value corresponds to that clause not reaching this source at all.

The observed +5.347% is strictly above the ceiling of every 5% (ranged) story and strictly below a full-uptime 8% story, and lands on 1 + 0.08·(2/3) = 1.053333 — i.e. the melee Expose Weakness amp honoured over its 4 s window — to within display rounding (297.46 -> 297.5).

The one competing arithmetic fit (Black Cleaver 4 -> 5 stacks) needs a ~237-armor target, which a base-stat roster scenario does not produce, and would contradict docs/math-foundations.md §2.3 in both directions.
Nothing in the cached wiki text or in docs/math-foundations.md supports the old value as the honest model of the two effects in combination.
limitations: The scenario input tuple is not present anywhere in the permitted evidence tree (data/ + docs/math-foundations.md), so this is a constraint/fingerprint verification of the DELTA, not an absolute re-derivation of 297.5 from champion base stats.

The verdict flips to 'both_wrong' if the scenario's target armor is ~232-242 AND the change was a Black Cleaver stack-count change to full 5 stacks — in that case neither 282.4 (0.8·C constant) nor 297.5 (full C) equals the exact Cesàro mean C − C(C−1)/(2h) recommended by docs/math-foundations.md §2.3.

If the Bloodsong holder in this roster is RANGED, the correct amp is 5% and no uptime can produce the observed +5.347%; the verdict would then be 'both_wrong' (old missing the amp, new using the melee branch). This is the single check that would settle the receipt and it requires the scenario roster, which the runbook forbids reading.
